question: Are the independently-recovered LIGO / GPS / pulsar clock-rate signatures ONE law -- the proper-time relation dtau/dt = 1 + Phi/c^2 - v^2/(2c^2)?
common_law: dtau/dt = 1 + Phi/c^2 - v^2/(2 c^2)  (weak-field proper time)

systems.name: GPS (eccentric Galileo)
systems.dataset: raw RINEX pseudorange, IGS stations BRUX/ALGO (2-3 days)
systems.projection: periodic part of dtau/dt along an eccentric orbit; coefficient -2/c^2
systems.significance: z=380 vs scramble null (E18, detection); coeff scatter +/-0.30 over 13 replicas

systems.name: Pulsar PSR B1913+16 (Einstein delay)
systems.observable: Einstein-delay gamma (grav. redshift + 2nd-order Doppler of pulsar clock)
systems.projection: static/orbit-averaged part of dtau/dt in companion potential -> gamma
systems.significance: gamma recovered to 0.014% of published GR value; dP_b/dt ratio 1.005

systems.name: LIGO GW170817 (BNS chirp)
systems.observable: chirp mass M_c via TaylorF2 matched filter
systems.projection: integrated PN proper-time phase evolution of the inspiral
systems.significance: net SNR 14.8 (L1 null 9.7 sigma); H1=L1 independently; 0.19%% from catalog

systems.name: LIGO GW150914 (ridge, method-limited)
systems.projection: Newtonian late-inspiral proper-time chirp (known ~24% high bias)
systems.significance: ridge fit R^2=0.995; absolute M_c biased high (Newtonian late-inspiral)

universality.formal_error_caveat: weighted chi^2 uses each probe's formal error; GPS uses real multi-replica scatter (honest), but pulsar gamma and LIGO bank errors are optimistic (per their own probes). The ROBUST headline is the point-estimate agreement (max_abs_deviation_pct) + the system-to-system spread (robust_std_R), NOT the formal chi^2.

reading.DATA: Three independent raw-data extractions, three methods, three regimes spanning ~9.0 decades in (v/c)^2, each recover the GR proper-time coefficient: ratios R = ['1.1433', '1.0001', '1.0019'] (each within 14.3% of unity); system-to-system spread 0.082.
reading.INTERPRETATION: The three observables are different projections of ONE relation: GPS = its periodic part (-2(r.v)/c^2), pulsar gamma = its orbit-averaged grav-redshift+2nd-order-Doppler part, LIGO = its integrated PN proper-time phase. They reduce to one law.
reading.FRAME: POSITIVE CONTROL, not new physics: this IS the equivalence principle / GR proper time -- established. The non-trivial part is that the OD tool, run independently on three raw datasets in three regimes, lands on the same proper-time coefficient. GW150914 ridge is reported but excluded from the strict fit (known Newtonian-late-inspiral absolute-mass bias).
